rv.q: Finn brilliantly uses musical comedy to explore what constitutes a family, while humanizing the extensive tragedy of the AIDS epidemic.
The time has never been riper for a revival of this beautiful show.
It's more like a 'really nice' than a transformative 'OMG,' but still, all these years later, 'Falsettos' still deserves high-pitched praise.
The revival cast is nearly flawless, each member showing more nuance and complexity even than in their most recent stage roles.
The cast is a thoroughly winsome one, which compensates for the first act becoming at points a bit repetitious
